deskSetAboutLicencesLead: Open-source software in this wallet. Each component keeps its own licence; the full texts are one click away.

@deskSetAboutLicencesLead.description: Settings › About › Licences: the paragraph before the list of components. The phone's version says 'tap' (licencesLead).

deskSetAboutLicenceApp: Epic Cash Desktop by BT Labs: Apache-2.0.

@deskSetAboutLicenceApp.description: Settings › About › Licences: the app's own licence. Epic Cash Desktop, BT Labs, Apache-2.0 and GitHub are names: keep them.

@deskSetAboutBrowserNotOpened.description: Toast title when a link could not be opened in the web browser; the link follows.

@deskSetAboutOpen.description: Small button on a link row of Settings › About: open the link in the browser.

@deskSetAboutVersion.description: Settings › About: the app's version, e.g. 'Version  26.10.2 · core 0.1.0'. Two spaces before the value, as in the English.

@deskSetAboutNode.description: Settings › About: the version of the Epic node the wallet uses, or '-'. Two spaces before the value, as in the English.

@deskSetAboutCommunity.description: Settings › About: group head of the Epic Cash community links (Telegram, epiccash.com).

@deskSetAboutLicences.description: Settings › About: group head of the open-source licences.

@deskSetAboutSource.description: Settings › About › Licences: row with the link to the app's source code.

@deskSetAboutView.description: Small button on the All licence texts row: open the page with every licence text.

@deskSetAboutChecked.description: Settings › About › Updates: when the app last asked for updates, e.g. 'Checked 5 min ago.' or 'Checked just now.' The {ago} part comes from deskSetAboutAgo*.

@deskSetAboutLatest.description: Settings › About › Updates: this version is the newest.

@deskSetAboutAvailable.description: Settings › About › Updates: a newer version exists.

@deskSetAboutCouldNotCheck.description: Settings › About › Updates: the update check failed; the reason follows.

@deskSetAboutUpdates.description: Settings › About: group head of the update check.

@deskSetAboutAgoNow.description: Fills {ago} in deskSetAboutChecked: less than a minute ago. Lower case.

@deskSetAboutAgoMin.description: Fills {ago} in deskSetAboutChecked: minutes ago (1 to 59). Lower case; 'min' is the short unit.

@deskSetAboutAgoHours.description: Fills {ago} in deskSetAboutChecked: hours ago (1 to 23). Lower case; 'h' is the short unit.

@deskSetAboutAgoDays.description: Fills {ago} in deskSetAboutChecked: days ago. Lower case; 'd' is the short unit.

@deskSetAboutCopyLink.description: Tooltip and screen reader label of the small copy icon beside a link.

@deskSetAboutCopied.description: Shown in place of Copy link for a moment after the link was copied.

@deskSetAboutNotCopied.description: Shown in place of Copy link for a moment when copying failed.
